title: Bounded faithfully flat ind-etale extension to a w-contractible ring
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and let $\kappa$ be an infinite cardinal with $|A|\leq\kappa$. There exist a commutative ring $D$ and a faithfully flat ring map $A\to D$ [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map] that is ind-etale [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra], such that $|D|\leq\kappa^{2^{2^{2^\kappa}}}$ and every faithfully flat weakly etale ring map $D\to B$ [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra] has a ring retraction $B\to D$ (its composite with $D\to B$ is $\mathrm{id}_D$). The induced morphism of affine spectra [def-weil-affine-spectrum] $\operatorname{Spec}D\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is a one-member pro-etale covering [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering].

source.place: Tag 0983, proposition-find-w-contractible; Tag 0984, remark-size-w-contractible, cardinal bound for the constructed witness; Tag 0981, definition-w-contractible; covering clause by Tag 0989, definition-fpqc-covering, applied to a faithfully flat ind-etale affine morphism

proof.text: Set $C=C_A$ using [def-weil-pbc-strict-w-cover]. By [lem-weil-pbc-strict-w-cover], $A\to C$ is faithfully flat and ind-etale, $\operatorname{Spec}C$ is w-local, and all maximal local rings of $C$ are strictly henselian. The separate size theorem [lem-weil-pbc-strict-w-cover-size] gives $|C|\leq\kappa$. This is the bounded strict w-local stage, not yet the desired $D$.

source.place: Tag 0983, proposition-find-w-contractible, first sentence of proof; Tag 0984, remark-size-w-contractible, first three stages

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-component-ring-pullback], $P=\pi_0(\operatorname{Spec}C)$ is profinite and is homeomorphic to the closed point set, hence $|P|\leq 2^\kappa$: each maximal ideal is a subset of $C$, so there are at most $2^{|C|}\leq2^\kappa$ of them. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-bounded-extremally-disconnected-cover] with the infinite cardinal $\lambda=2^\kappa$. Obtain an extremally disconnected profinite $T$ and a continuous surjection $u:T\to P$ with $|T|\leq2^{2^{2^\kappa}}$.

source.place: Tag 0983, choice of T; Tag 0984, bound on the maximal ideal set; Topology Tags 090D and 090E

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-component-ring-pullback] to $C,T,u$. It supplies $C\to D$ ind-Zariski and ind-etale, the cartesian spectrum description, $\pi_0(\operatorname{Spec}D)\cong T$, a w-local spectrum, closed points over closed points of $C$, and isomorphisms on every local ring. In particular if $\mathfrak m$ is maximal in $D$, its contraction $\mathfrak n$ in $C$ is maximal and $D_{\mathfrak m}\cong C_{\mathfrak n}$. Thus it is strictly henselian by step 1. Surjectivity of $u$ gives surjectivity on spectra. Ind-etale composition in [lem-weil-pbc-ind-etale-stability] makes $A\to D$ ind-etale and hence weakly etale, in particular flat by [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]. Both maps of spectra are surjective (for $A\to C$ use [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-surjective-spectrum]); their composite is surjective. Therefore [lem-weil-pbc-flat-surjective-spectrum-faithfully-flat] makes $A\to D$ faithfully flat.

source.place: Tag 0983, profinite pullback and preservation paragraph; Tag 097D; Tag 096C; Tag 096T; Algebra Tag 00HQ

proof.text: The geometric conditions required by [lem-weil-pbc-wcontractible-geometric-criterion] now hold for $R=D$: w-locality and strict henselianity are from step 3, and the component space is homeomorphic to the extremally disconnected $T$ of step 2. This criterion gives a retraction $r:B\to D$ of every faithfully flat weakly etale $f:D\to B$, with $r\circ f=\mathrm{id}_D$. No inference from ind-etale splitting to weakly etale splitting is left implicit: the cited criterion states the latter.

source.place: Tag 0982, implication (3) to (1); Tag 0983, final sentence

proof.text: For each maximal $\mathfrak m$ of $D$, step 3 gives $D_{\mathfrak m}\cong C_{\mathfrak n}$. Fractions in $C_{\mathfrak n}$ are represented by pairs in $C\times C$, so $|D_{\mathfrak m}|\leq\kappa$ since $\kappa$ is infinite. The maximal ideal set of $D$ is homeomorphic to $T$ by [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-component-ring-pullback]. The diagonal map $D\to\prod_{\mathfrak m\text{ maximal}}D_{\mathfrak m}$ is injective: if $d\ne0$, its annihilator is proper, choose a maximal ideal containing it; vanishing of $d/1$ there would give $s\notin\mathfrak m$ with $sd=0$, a contradiction. Thus, putting $\mu=2^{2^{2^\kappa}}$, we have $|D|\leq\prod_{\mathfrak m}|D_{\mathfrak m}|\leq\kappa^{|T|}\leq\kappa^\mu$. For the zero ring the product is empty and the injection and bound still hold. These are counting of fractions, injection of sets, and monotonicity of cardinal powers; no additional construction theorem is used.

source.place: Tag 0984, final paragraph: local rings, maximal ideal bound, and injection into their product

proof.text: Let $f:\operatorname{Spec}D\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be the induced morphism. It is weakly etale by step 3 and [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]. To check the covering condition on an arbitrary affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}R\subset\operatorname{Spec}A$, first apply [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-affine-schemes-affine]: $V=f^{-1}(U)$ is an affine open of $\operatorname{Spec}D$. This inverse image represents the pullback along $U\hookrightarrow\operatorname{Spec}A$: a morphism to $\operatorname{Spec}D$ whose composite factors through $U$ factors uniquely through its open inverse image $V$. The fibre-product calculation [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra] identifies $V=\operatorname{Spec}(R\otimes_A D)$ over $U$, with structure map $r\mapsto r\otimes1$. This map is faithfully flat by [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-base-change], since $A\to D$ is faithfully flat. By [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-surjective-spectrum] it is surjective on spectra, so $f(V)=U$. For this $U$, choose one index and the single affine open $V$ in the sole member of the family; its image equals $U$. If $U$ is empty one may instead choose no opens. Therefore the singleton satisfies the finite-affine-open condition of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering] for every affine open and is a pro-etale covering.

lean.statement: theorem exists_bounded_wContractible_extension (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (κ : Cardinal.{u}) (hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ) (hA : Cardinal.mk A ≤ κ) : ∃ (D : Type u) (_ : CommRing D) (f : A →+* D), f.FaithfullyFlat ∧ f.IndEtale ∧ Cardinal.mk D ≤ κ ^ ((2 : Cardinal.{u}) ^ ((2 : Cardinal.{u}) ^ ((2 : Cardinal.{u}) ^ κ))) ∧ (∀ (B : Type (max u v)) [CommRing B] (g : D →+* B), g.FaithfullyFlat → g.WeaklyEtale → ∃ r : B →+* D, r.comp g = RingHom.id D) ∧ Presieve.singleton (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)) ∈ Scheme.proetalePrecoverage (Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
